analysis:
Integration of three batch analyses. The PR adds a 30s startup-discovery retry to the root fan helper (FanDaemon.swift, TB-010; T-046/T-047/T-048, A-014). Recovery is fenced by effectiveEnabled, power suspension and lifecycleRevision, which emergencyRestore, shutdown, sleep and wake all bump. The inventory/controller swap happens only with no possible ownership and no pending restorations. The swap clears the provider lease, so a fresh renewal is required before any SMC write. Discovery itself is read-only per the unit 0 review. The other two units (FanDaemonTestHarness extraction, FanStartupDiscoveryTests) are test-only and add no production attack surface. No coordinator, attestation, encryption, billing or XPC authentication code is touched. T-041 was supplied as a relevant definition but is unrelated to these changes. No concrete security regression was supported by the visible evidence, so there are no findings.

Residual uncertainty for any deeper pass:
(1) FanOwnershipRecovery.reconcile was not supplied. If it runs with an empty or unusable inventory, it might clear the ownership journal while fans or Ftst remain in manual mode. This is unverified.
(2) The content of FanStartupDiscoveryTests.swift was reported as unsupplied in unit 1 but visible in unit 2. Coverage of races should be confirmed against the actual tests.
(3) The production FanDaemon thermalState injection default was not examined beyond unit 0.
